text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, with the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
just around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――Alrighty. Wonder what tonight's gonna be 
like.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, more girls seem to be training 
without permission after lights-out, so I 
need to keep a close watch around here—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Isn't that over there—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —I knew it! Isn't that Ardan-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's almost lights-out time. Were you just 
finishing up cooling down?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was just about to head off. Thank 
you for your hard work on the Disciplinary 
Committee, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember right, your comeback date's 
been set, hasn't it?! Congrats! Training 
this late really shows your fighting 
spirit, as expected!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're all fired up to face Yaeno and the 
others again, aren't you~! I can't wait to 
see you run again soon, Senpai, su!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-senpai, could it be... you're 
feeling under the weather? You seem less 
energetic than usual, or something—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...You are truly a mysterious person, 
Bamboo-san. It's as if you can only ever 
see the truth."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...To be frank, I felt there was a 
problem with my running, and I've been 
agonizing over it."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A problem with her running? Could that 
mean... Are you talking about Senpai's 
leg, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No. ...It is simply a matter of my frame 
of mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems that during the rest period 
before I was finally able to resume 
training like this, I subconsciously felt 
something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The gap that lies between Oguri-san and 
myself. The difference in brilliance 
between one who stands at the center of an 
era, and one who does not—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...The passion and words of encouragement 
I received from Bamboo-san before going on 
break are something I haven't forgotten to 
this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I truly wanted to respond to the support 
you gave my "dream" one day, through my 
running. I genuinely felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I witnessed it with my own two eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Almost as if... promised to go down in 
history, with that vivid and peerless 
brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not only my sister's majesty, but I must 
also eclipse that dazzling new aurora; 
otherwise, I cannot leave my trail of 
light upon this era.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Once I understood that reality with 
complete clarity— a cold voice residing in 
the corner of my heart began to whisper to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"—With my frail light as it is now, it 
will simply fade away, she said."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I know full well that I must not lend 
an ear to such cowardly words. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
These legs, this body, this heart are 
still heavy... And that... frustrates me 
so.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"For real, Oguri-senpai is amazing. People 
are saying it's gonna be Oguri-senpai's 
era now, and her races totally back that 
up."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: However, even so—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I don't believe for a second that 
Ardan-senpai— her resolve, her 'dream'— is 
in any way inferior!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...Thank you for your concern. However—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm not flattering you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—What about the resolve I felt when 
Ardan-senpai told me about her "dream"?! 
What about the way she ran in the Japanese 
Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's so hot...! So dazzling...!! 
Everything that I'm not!! So cool!!! So 
incredible!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That belongs to Ardan-senpai alone!! With 
Ardan-senpai's own passion and strength, 
it's her "dream"!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why you can still run, 
Ardan-senpai! You can challenge 
Oguri-senpai! You can chase after your 
"dream"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Even if Ardan-senpai can't believe it—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I believe in Ardan-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Right now, I'm aimin' for somethin' big. 
To become the absolute strongest and 
greatest Umamusume in Sprints and Miles."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sprint and mile. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! I might even end up racing 
against Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not gonna lose!! I'll challenge 
Oguri-senpai, win, and prove that I'm the 
strongest, ultimate best at the mile!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because that's the path that leads to my 
"dream" right now!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to chase your 
"dream" again, Ardan-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's almost lights-out time. I'll be 
heading off as well. ...Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ardan-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty! Time to warm up before Trainer 
gets here~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-senpai! Thank you for your hard 
work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Good work. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes! Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
…………Um. May I ask what your next target 
race is, Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? About the upcoming Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen, though—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...In that case, could I come 
see you run in person next time, 
Bamboo-san?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You're coming to watch me!! Thank 
you so much!! I'm so, so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what's with the sudden request? 
Saying you want to see me race and all—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just as you reached out to touch my 
"dream," I, too, wanted to touch yours... 
That is what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me feel it through your 
running. The sheer heat of your "dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, understood!! I'll 
definitely get it across!! My passion, my 
determination, my "dream"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! I'm fired upppp!!!! I'm gonna 
win!! The Takamatsunomiya Kinen!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's great challenge was about 
to beginâ
